test_title: SSC CGL Tier-II (AAO) 2023 Official Paper-III (Held On: 27 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The salary paid to Mr. Virat, a clerk, for the month of August 2023, debited to the furniture account instead of the salary account will be regarded as a / an _______.
solution:
The correct answer is **error of principle.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Error of Principle:**

 
 
• This type of error occurs when a transaction is recorded in violation of accounting principles. In this case, the salary expense, which should be recorded in the salary account, is incorrectly debited to the furniture account.
 
• Errors of principle usually involve the incorrect classification of accounts, leading to inaccurate financial statements.
 
• These errors are often more serious than other types because they can significantly distort the financial position of the enterprise.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Error of Omission:**

 
 
• This error occurs when a transaction is completely omitted from the accounting records. In this scenario, the transaction is recorded but in the wrong account.
 
 
 
• **Compensating Error:**
 
 
• These are errors that counterbalance each other. For example, an overstatement of one account may be offset by an understatement of another. This is not applicable here as only one transaction is incorrectly recorded.
 
 
 
• **Error of Commission:**
 
 
• This type of error occurs when an entry is made in the correct type of account but in the wrong account. For example, debiting the wrong customer account in accounts receivable. The given scenario involves an error in the type of account, not just the wrong account within the same category.
